title: Dragonfly-style Titan entry · 2035

events.kind: Entry interface · 1,270 km; no landing model

note: Dragonfly-inspired EdvES transfer with a separately targeted Titan arrival on 2035-11-27T20:26:26 TDB. NASA's current Dragonfly plan reaches Titan in late 2034; this November 2035 case is not its operational trajectory or a date match. Retains the finite 2028 launch and 2031 Earth flyby; adds a 14.581 m/s cruise DSM on 2032-04-18T08:57:04 TDB. Total onboard cruise delta-v 428.480 m/s; launcher injection excluded. No Saturn SOI burn. Titan entry at 1,270 km altitude, 8.4902 km/s moon-relative inertial speed, flight-path angle -51.276 degrees. The Arrival V-infinity metric is Saturn-relative at SOI entry, not Titan entry speed. Sun-only cruise, Saturn plus differential Titan gravity locally; no other moons, solar tides inside SOI, J2, rings, atmosphere, descent or landing. No landing-site targeting. Lowest added burn of three tested timings; not a global optimum.
